name: Silo soUSDC SiloVault externally credited wstUSR-market shares inflate totalAssets
summary: SiloVault.totalAssets() sums previewRedeem of the vault's share balance in every withdraw-queue market, so bUSDC shares a third party mints to the vault through wstUSR/USDC market.deposit(assets, receiver=soUSDC) raise soUSDC's share price without minting soUSDC shares and without the curator allocating. That market prices wstUSR collateral with an immutable wstUSR/stUSR exchange-rate feed (1.1330 USDC) while wstUSR traded near 0.12 after the USR depeg. Each cycle flash-borrowed USDC, deposited into soUSDC, donated USDC into the wstUSR market for soUSDC, borrowed that USDC back against wstUSR, and redeemed the inflated soUSDC shares from healthy markets, leaving soUSDC holding undercollateralised wstUSR-market shares.

loss.notes: Exact net USDC outflow from the soUSDC victim set (vault plus its ten withdraw-queue markets) to attacker contracts across all 32 successful campaign transactions from five actors, 1775223466 to 1775231146. Attacker USDC deposits into soUSDC and USDC donated into the wstUSR market are netted as attacker inputs; zero-fee flash loans from 0x6c247b1f6182318877311737bac0844baa518f5e net to zero. The total equals soUSDC totalAssets() of 359680.779038 USDC at block 448623206 to within 0.157 USDC. The 377529.207693 wstUSR the attackers pledged as collateral in the wstUSR market, worth about $45.5k at the DefiLlama incident price of 0.12059 (source-9), stays pledged to attacker-held borrow positions and is not deducted. The $392k reported figure is the nominal wstUSR-market exposure; BlockSec reports $359k.

ageReset.description: acceptCap(wstUSR/USDC market 0xa9a4bd976dbcfc2b89f554467ac85e2c758e2618), executed by curator Safe 0x80071b39aa896aa12240c5194e42661d671bdfb2, enabled the market and pushed it onto soUSDC's withdrawQueue (SetWithdrawQueue at log 1, SetCap(1e13) at log 2). config(market) changes from (0, false, 0) at block 378417292 to (1e13, true, 0) at block 378417293 and still returns (1e13, true, 0) at block 448623206. From this change totalAssets() counts the vault's shares in the market whose immutable oracle prices wstUSR at the exchange rate; the market stayed in the queue through the exploit.

EIP-1167 clone whose 45-byte runtime hardcodes ChainlinkV3Oracle logic 0x4db912bfe4385274a51fc55ff671da71b02d1fc7; the same transaction created its immutable ChainlinkV3OracleConfig 0xabbbc66646fd03961ad3144d128782979aff360b, which selects Chainlink 'wstUSR / stUSR Exchange Rate' 0x9bc7e5a6f1eed1c3217d2c63ad680df83d84a906 as the only price leg (convertToQuote false, no USR/USD leg). Neither the clone pointer nor the config can change.

limitations: Not the knot: the oracle clone and its config were created at block 375611456, and SiloConfig 0x6b5ac2967a03908b5e9af6288d86c7139f586b3f bound it to the wstUSR market at block 376970206. Both precede target-1's reset at block 378417293, when soUSDC began counting that market, so target-1 supplies the curve age. The exchange-rate price alone would have exposed only the market's own 1.058179 USDC of liquidity.

sources.note: Verified SiloVault source for 0x2514a2ce842705ead703d02fabfd8250bfcfb8bd: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode, chainid=42161. ContractName SiloVault, v0.8.28+commit.7893614a, optimizer 200 runs, cancun. SHA-256 of the SourceCode field: 795939da519cf09a7b4a30d0aefbbc94ca606d6d0e916f97dba53982648ec3ab. In silo-vaults/contracts/SiloVault.sol, totalAssets() loops over withdrawQueue and adds SiloVaultActionsLib.expectedSupplyAssets(market) = market.previewRedeem(market.balanceOf(vault)). Nothing separates shares the vault supplied itself (tracked in balanceTracker) from shares a third party minted to it through market.deposit(assets, receiver), and no soUSDC shares are minted for them. SiloVaultActionsLib.setCap pushes a market onto withdrawQueue the first time a nonzero cap is accepted.

Target-1 identity and age. soUSDC SiloVault 0x2514a2ce842705ead703d02fabfd8250bfcfb8bd is a direct runtime: eth_getCode is empty at block 370175910, and keccak equals 0x98f9c367...d5ec at 370175911 and 448623206 (20520 bytes). EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero. Each of the 14 DELEGATECALL opcodes targets the linked library SiloVaultActionsLib 0x25cedb0caf2ea68b7160b316ad5a00b8c519fb19 (address embedded 14 times), so the code cannot be upgraded. Created by CREATE2 from 0xe4c72e535eb3fd547615b19ffe56497c10783841 inside source-2 (block 370175911 index 1; sender 0x620d7e459cffcdc56a874536dc19147de801a4a1 via multisend 0x40a2accbd92bca938b02010e17a5b8929b49130d). Configuration history: Etherscan logs.getLogs on the vault, blocks 370175911..448623207. SetCap topic 0x10dbbfa98a21bc7a80d86cb89391600c590e0e2ce25698013741bcad42956569 returns 10 events; the wstUSR market's only one is block 378417293 log 2, cap 1e13, following SubmitCap in source-7 (block 377372142). SetWithdrawQueue topic 0x834ae37621cd31f2636b1cb6f1bded844d79ecf755af866b5d896da642d7b567 returns 17 events: the market first appears at block 378417293 log 1 and is in all 9 later queues through block 444354418 (reorders only). SubmitMarketRemoval returns 0 events. The declared view-call reproduces config(market) before and after the reset; withdrawQueue(4) is the market at block 448623206. Necessity: totalAssets counts only withdrawQueue markets, so without this enablement the externally minted bUSDC-149 shares would not raise the share price; the later cap value is not necessary. The reset post-dates vault deployment (370175911), oracle creation (375611456) and market creation (SiloConfig 0x6b5ac296 and silo 0xa9a4bd97 in 0xa40e4706effaee9a07b66ab33dc843f4744ed9291b84ab89d35723f84d53793b at block 376970206), so it is the latest age reset. Age 1775223466 - 1757692266 = 17531200 s.

Target-2 identity and age. The wstUSR collateral silo's solvency oracle 0x836a1ab8151db99ce5d4978d535595eb1604425e has an EIP-1167 runtime (363d3d373d3d3d363d73 4db912bf... 5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3), keccak 0x8b835ba7...4eec.
